facets.description: addGuests.handler.ts lines 74-78: blacklist check is case-sensitive because the guest email is not lowercased while blacklist entries are, so mixed-case addresses bypass it
addGuests.handler.ts line 76: existing-attendee dedupe compares raw strings (case-sensitive), so a mixed-case email can duplicate an existing attendee
addGuests.handler.ts: duplicate emails within the submitted guests list are not removed server-side (only the client checks), so createMany inserts duplicate attendees
addGuests.handler.ts line 52: isAttendee permission comparison (attendee.email === user.email) is case-sensitive
